evidence.excerpt: We launched our YC startup with a tech stack that costs $14.99/month. Every tool on this list is open source, self-hostable, and has zero vendor lock-in. Dokploy (@getdokploy) on a Hetzner VPS: Self-hosted PaaS with Docker templates and seamless CI/CD. Replaced Vercel and AWS for us. Can't recommend this enough. @better_auth - TypeScript-native authentication with full control over your user data, and one we wish we'd picked over Firebase. Rybbit (@yang_frog) - Privacy-friendly user analytics.…
